about: Reviewed places where two Digitakt mods meet on the same stock bytes; read by scripts/module-compat.py (npm run modules:compat, part of npm run check). Any overlap not listed here fails, and so does an entry naming a mod that no longer exists or a site where nothing meets any more. pending-event: the core does not own the site yet; the entry names the planned core events and lasts until both mods subscribe. New entries need owner review; for shared behaviour, propose a core event instead (docs/module-guides/README.md#propose-an-event).

relations.until: the Digitakt core owns these sites as events and both mods subscribe; digichain shows the dispatch the core needs
relations.reason: digichain owns the SRC page and render sites once and passes each call to the mod whose machine it is for (its README); NEIGHBOR patches the same sites for its own machine. The pair is a declared conflict: the builder refuses NEIGHBOR beside digichain.
